note: Synthetic snapshot for the tl-7y6.1.2 stage-2 importer tests: invented bead ids, numbers and dates. The real stage snapshot does not exist in the worktree yet (docs/study/README.md); nothing here is real tracker data.

beads.title: Synthetic: smaller slices
beads.description:
## Description
Speed up landing by cutting beads into smaller stages.

## Experiment
hypothesis: smaller slices raise the beads landed per day
metric: landed beads/day
baseline: 0.14
check_when: date 2026-11-02
keep_if: landed beads/day stays >= 0.2 for a whole week
revert: git revert the slice commits and re-freeze the 2026-10-25 baseline

beads.title: Synthetic: cheaper verify
beads.description:
## Experiment
hypothesis: a cheaper verify stage cuts the slot minutes each landed bead costs
metric: slot_min_per_landed
baseline: 134
check_when: 6 runs since 2026-10-26
keep_if: slot-min per landed bead <= 120 over the window
revert: drop the verify trim config and rerun the release gate
created: 2026-10-27

beads.title: Synthetic: fewer verify asks
beads.description:
## Experiment
hypothesis: fewer verify asks cut the avoidable asks per week
metric: avoidable asks/week
baseline: 3
check_when: 2026-11-09
keep_if: avoidable asks/week <= 1 for two straight weeks
revert: restore the old ask policy line and re-freeze the baseline

beads.title: Synthetic: warm gate cache
beads.description:
## Experiment
hypothesis: a warm gate cache halves the median release-gate minutes
metric: median release-gate minutes
baseline: 2.5
check_when: runs 4 since 2026-10-26
keep_if: median release-gate minutes <= 1.5 over the window
revert: turn the gate cache off and re-freeze the baseline

beads.title: Synthetic: inlined brief facts (with decoy blocks)
beads.description:
## Description
This description says the word experiment in prose and carries decoy fields that must never be extracted.

keep_if: DECOY from the Description block
metric: decoy

## Experiments:
hypothesis: DECOY plural heading is not an Experiment block
metric: decoy
baseline: 999
check_when: date 2099-01-01
keep_if: decoy
revert: decoy

## Experiment
hypothesis: first-run landings rise when the brief carries inlined facts
metric: landed_run1_share
baseline: 0.36
check_when: date 2026-11-16
keep_if: beads landed on run 1 >= 0.5 of landed
revert: move the facts back out of the brief and re-freeze the baseline

beads.title: Synthetic: revert follow-ups (wrapped hypothesis)
beads.description:
## Experiment
hypothesis: linking each revert to its landing within a week
 lowers reverts per 100 landings
metric: reverts per 100 landings
baseline: 0
check_when: 3 runs since 2026-10-27
keep_if: reverts per 100 landings <= 5 over the window
revert: unlink the follow-up and re-freeze the baseline

beads.title: Synthetic: staged review (closed bead, never verdicted)
beads.description:
## Description
Closed bead whose experiment never got a verdict; counting is by verdict, not bead status.

## Experiment
hypothesis: a staged review keeps runs per landed bead near two
metric: runs per landed bead
baseline: 3
check_when: date 2026-11-23
keep_if: runs per landed bead <= 2.5 over the window
revert: go back to one-shot review and re-freeze the baseline

beads.title: Synthetic: earlier kill of hung steps
beads.description:
## Experiment
hypothesis: killing hung steps earlier cuts the non-landing slot-min share
metric: non-landing slot-min share
baseline: 0.56
check_when: 1 run since 2026-10-26
keep_if: non-landing slot-min share <= 0.45 over the window
revert: restore the old kill timeout and re-freeze the baseline
